standard_title: Gold and Gold Alloys Jewellery/Artefacts - guide/fineness and marking
legal_basis_or_qco: Hallmarking (Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts) Order, notified under BIS Act 2016; registered jewellers required
testing_required: Yes (purity/fineness testing at BIS-recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centre)
required_mark_or_label: BIS Standard Mark, purity/fineness grade, 6-digit alphanumeric HUID
manufacturer_or_importer_notes: Jeweller must be registered with BIS (instant, free online registration on manakonline.in) before selling hallmarked jewellery
consumer_verification_method: Verify the HUID via the BIS CARE mobile app
source_page_title: Hallmarking overview - Bureau of Indian Standards

product_name: Electronics and IT goods (as notified, e.g. laptops, mobile chargers)
mandatory_or_voluntary: Mandatory (for products specifically notified under CRS orders)
legal_basis_or_qco: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (7 Sept 2012), as expanded by later notifications
required_mark_or_label: BIS Standard Mark with unique Registration (R) Number
manufacturer_or_importer_notes: Registration is granted per manufacturer/factory location and brand; only products specifically named in a notified CRO/QCO are covered - not all electronics
consumer_verification_method: Check the product's R-Number on the CRS registered-manufacturers page or BIS CARE app

product_name: Solar photovoltaics, systems, devices and components (as notified)
legal_basis_or_qco: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2017, notified by Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), dated 05 September 2017
required_mark_or_label: BIS Standard Mark with unique Registration (R) Number
manufacturer_or_importer_notes: Manufacturers must get the product tested at a BIS-recognised lab before applying for registration
consumer_verification_method: Check the product's R-Number on the CRS registered-manufacturers page or BIS CARE app

product_name: Any product notified under a Quality Control Order (QCO)
mandatory_or_voluntary: Mandatory for the specific product varieties named in that QCO; BIS certification is otherwise voluntary
legal_basis_or_qco: Quality Control Order issued by the concerned Central Government Ministry/Department under BIS Act 2016 or other applicable Acts
certification_scheme: ISI Mark (Product Certification, Scheme-I) or applicable scheme named in the QCO
required_mark_or_label: ISI Standard Mark under a BIS product certification licence
manufacturer_or_importer_notes: The definitive, currently-in-force list of products under compulsory certification is maintained live on the official BIS page below and was not reproduced here in full, since it changes as new QCOs are notified
consumer_verification_method: Search the product/HS code against the official compulsory-certification list
source_page_title: Products under Compulsory Certification - Bureau of Indian Standards
